entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie, agent ID 402. How can I help you today?
I need to start a return for a VeloBand. Just give me the return number.
I can certainly help you with that. To pull up your account, could I get the order number?
(Sighs) Fine. It's VF99-2025-1215. Let's just get this done.
Thank you. One moment... Okay, I see the VeloBand GPS Tracker, delivered 24 days ago. Before we proceed, could I ask what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?

It's not broken. Look, I know it's past your little window. We had a major family emergency. My husband needed emergency surgery and was in the hospital for weeks. I wasn't exactly thinking about returning a fitness tracker.

I'm very sorry to hear about that, and I hope your husband is on the mend. But there's no need to worry about the timeline. I'm looking at your account, and you're well within our 90-day return policy.
Ninety days? Really? I thought it was shorter. Okay, good. So you'll process the full refund?

Yes, absolutely. Since it's within the 90-day period, you're all set for a full refund. I've just processed the return authorization in our system. You'll receive an email with a prepaid shipping label in the next few minutes.
Perfect. That's all I needed. Thank you.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a good rest of your day.
